collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager lies awake listening to frogs singing near the stream.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (name1) lies awake listening to frogs singing near the stream. The croaking rises and falls like a slow song.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (name1) lies awake listening to frogs singing near the stream. One frog is noticeably louder than all the others, and (name1) laughs.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (name1) lies awake listening to frogs singing near the stream. The chorus stops suddenly, and the silence feels enormous.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (name1) lies awake listening to frogs singing near the stream. (name1) falls asleep before the frogs do.
